title: Juicy British Sausage Sausage In Hole
description: A comforting, spicy, light British dish featuring truffle oil, steam, and a nut-free-friendly twist on the classic toad-in-the-hole. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, and milk to make the batter.
Add the chopped onion and mix well.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish or a 12-cup muffin tin, leaving a 1/2 inch space between each cup.
Arrange the sausages in the batter, making sure they are fully covered.
Drizzle the truffle oil over the sausages.
Cover the baking dish or muffin tin with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the sausages are cooked through and the batter is golden brown.
